question: Which river flows between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narmada**:-

 
 
• **The Narmada River flows between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges in central India. (Hence option 1 is correct).**
 
• It is one of the oldest rivers in the world, and is considered to be sacred by Hindus.
 
• The Narmada River flows west for 1,312 kilometers before draining into the Arabian Sea.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Godavari River:-**

 
 
• It originates from Nasik and rises at an elevation of 1,067 m from Trimbakeshwar (Nasik district of Maharashtra), 80 km from the Arabian Sea.
 
• Godavari's total length from its origin to its outfall into the Bay of Bengal is 1,465 km. 
 
 
 
• **Son River:-**
 
 
• It originates from the Amarkantak plateau in the Anuppur district of Madhya Pradesh. 
 
• It flows through Madhya Pradesh, Chhatisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand and finally joins Ganga in Bihar near Patna.
 
• The Bansagar Dam in Madhya Pradesh is also on the Son river.
 
 
 
• **Mahanadi River**
 
 
• It is a river in central India, rising in the hills of southeastern Chhattisgarh state and has a total course of 858 kilometers (533 mi). 
 
• The river originates from Sihawa Mountain in Chhattisgarh.
 
• The largest dam, the Hirakud Dam is built on the river.
